text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One night, as I'm heading home after
work, I
come across Sakura Chiyono O
peering curiously
at something.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh... I thought I heard a familiar
voice coming
from the kitchen, so...
BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BANG!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? HA HA HA HA! Looks like you've
caught me
red-handed in the midst of
my secret training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough! I-is all that black stuff... burned sweets?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I want to give some to my sister, so I'm
putting in
extra Bakushin effort!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other day, Sakura Bakushin O
walked off saying she'd realized what
her sister needed—and
that she had to
prepare it alone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So you're saying what she needs...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Talking about it the other day
brought
back memories of the first time I
tried to bake
sweets like her.
choice_data_list: Homemade sweets... made by Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
They turned out just as badly as they did
today!
But when she saw me down in the
dumps, you
know what she said?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little ...
text_block_list.text:
Aw, Big Sis! Delicate work's really not
your strong
suit, huh? But that's why I
love them—they remind
me of you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! That's all there is to it!
Baking,
running—it's all about doing it
your own way!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My sister doesn't need to copy my
Bakushin. She
just has to run like herself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll get that across by giving her these
sweets that
I baked my own way...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Crammed full of my love and support!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It seems you were right to believe in her,
Trainer.
Hehe. Shall we be on our way?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little ...
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A pick-me-up? Oh! These
sweets—you
made them yourself, didn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little ...
text_block_list.text: Crunch... Hehe... hahaha! Talk about bitter! They're just how I remember!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
These sweets are your answer, dear
sister. They're
nothing like what you can
make, but that's just
fine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your running isn't like mine—and that's
fine too!
Don't let Bakushin hold you
back!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little ...
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best for the race! I'm gonna go
all-out
Bakushin, just like you!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little ...
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff! I've gotta Bakushin... even harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There are sweets only you can make.
The same
goes for your running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My running is Bakushin. But that doesn't
have to
be true for you.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little ...
text_block_list.text:
Just like your sweets... I have my own
running
style?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little ...
text_block_list.text:
I get it. I'm not you, or anyone else. I'm
me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little ...
text_block_list.text: I want to win a race... and I'll do it my way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, another Uma Kids Footrace
Meet
rolls around. How will the results
turn out this
time?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Yes! Second place! Can you believe
it?! She
came in second place!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little ...
text_block_list.text: Big Siiis! I did iiit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the questionable quality of the
sweets, they helped the sisters get
through to each other.
Now their bond is
deeper than ever.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Look, she came sixth! She worked
so hard,
and it paid off!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little ...
text_block_list.text: Big Siiis! I did it! I ran my own way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the questionable quality of the
sweets, they helped the sisters make a
breakthrough.
Now, step by step,
they're making progress.
